text: もりは　てんねんの　めいろよ　まよわないよう　きを　つけて

structure.jp: もりは　てんねんの　めいろよ
structure.en: the forest is a natural maze
so as not to get lost

patterns.name: 〜ように
patterns.explanation: ように after a verb gives the aim: so that. まよわないよう = 'so you won't get lost'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A bare て-form is a friendly, casual request. きを　つけて = 'be careful'.
